skill.title: A new clue
skill.promise: You can update a count with a clue.

lessons.title: Update the count

screens.prompt: Bag A has 4 red and 1 blue. Bag B has 1 red and 4 blue. A red draw is more likely from...

feedback.wrong_option: Bag B has more blue. Red is more likely from the bag with more red.

screens.prompt: Bag A has 5 chips and 1 is blue. Set the red count.

feedback.too_low: Red is the rest of the bag. Move up.
feedback.too_high: Red is not every chip. Move down.

screens.prompt: You draw a red chip. Which bag becomes more likely?

feedback.wrong_option: A red chip fits Bag A better. Bag B is mostly blue.

screens.correctMessage: The red clue raises Bag A.

screens.prompt: A clue that matches Bag A better...

options.label: Leaves the chances where they started

feedback.wrong_option: A matching clue changes the count. It does not leave the chances put.

screens.correctMessage: A matching clue updates the chance.

screens.prompt: New clue: the chip is blue. Now the more likely bag is...

feedback.wrong_option: Blue fits the bag with more blue. That is Bag B.

screens.correctMessage: The blue clue flips the pick.

screens.prompt: Both bags have 5 chips. The clue is only that you drew a chip. The odds...

feedback.wrong_option: Both bags explain a chip equally. The clue adds no new count.

screens.correctMessage: A clue both bags share does not move the odds.

screens.prompt: Bag A started with 1 red out of 5. You add 3 red. Set the new red count.

feedback.too_low: Add the new red chips to the old count. Move up.
feedback.too_high: The new count is smaller than that. Move down.

screens.prompt: After a red clue, Pip picks...

feedback.wrong_option: A red clue supports the bag that holds more red.

screens.correctMessage: Pip picks the bag the clue supports.

lessons.whyItMatters: A new clue updates the count a model uses to pick.
